description: Find FERC Form 1 respondents (US investor-owned electric/gas utilities that file the annual FERC Form 1) by name. Returns the FERC respondent id to use in the other ferc1_* tools. found:false when no respondent matches.

query.description: Part of the utility name, e.g. "PacifiCorp" or "duke energy".

name: ferc1_find_utility
